//id: Stable handle for this declaration inside the registry. Optional - it defaults to this
file's basename without the extension. It must be unique across every loaded config file.
Load several declarations at once with ENGAGEMENTS_INDEX_SCHEMAS (comma/semicolon separated
file and/or directory paths); a directory contributes every *.json in it except *.example.json.
//fields: Declares the Azure AI Search index shape. Used two ways:
1. `provision:search ensure` builds createOrUpdateIndex from this list.
2. Query building checks `filterable`/`searchable` here BEFORE emitting an OData
$filter, so a mismatch fails with a clear message instead of an opaque HTTP 400.
When pointing at a customer's existing index, describe that index here - do not
provision over it. Set ENGAGEMENTS_INDEX_SCHEMA to use a different file.
type: Edm.String | Edm.Int32 | Edm.Int64 | Edm.Double | Edm.Boolean |
//mapping: Maps the logical fields this capability needs onto whatever they are called in the
index above. Every value must name a field in `fields`.
`payload` names a field holding the full JSON record; when it is null the backend
cannot losslessly reconstruct domain objects and read queries will report that.
